$comment: CortexAgent surface themes — 9 variants, 3 surfaces. Each entry maps a theme to its source mockup + avatar. Slugs are kebab-case; display names are Title Case. Surface assignment is FIXED (do not mix aesthetics on the same surface — see 'Surface UX feedback' 2026-08-19).

osint.label: OSINT Portal
osint.job: Go from a question to a saved, annotated subject.
osint.aesthetic: Casebook — warm paper, ink, hand-ruled margins.

security.label: Security Dashboard
security.job: Show what needs attention right now. Hide the rest.
security.aesthetic: Aviation HMI — graphite, amber accent, monospace numerics.

agent.label: CortexAgent WebUI
agent.job: Make the agent's process legible and inspectable.
agent.aesthetic: Textbook figure — white paper, teal ink, mathematical notation.

themes.description: Masonry of slightly-rotated index cards with colored pinheads on a dark wall. Decorative threads suggest connections.

Two-page notebook with red margin line, ruled paper, italic Garamond headings, numbered entries, margin notes gutter. Built-in image gallery + facts + save-to-case checkbox for LLM-extracted enrichment.
Annotated textbook figure on white paper. Five numbered stages with hand-drawn arrows, figure caption, latency budget footnote. Animated for live use: tokens flow through stages in real time.
Dark canvas with breathing pulse on the active stage. Live token strip at the bottom shows what the model is typing right now. Blinking caret on the output.
Git-log style history on warm-white paper. Each run shows hash + prompt + latency + status + token count. Click to expand stage breakdown and reply.
9 vertical gauge instruments with status bars. Big '3/9' central readout calls out what needs attention. Barograph strip at the bottom shows event density over 24h.
Three-column terminal layout. Left: subsystem tree. Center: live event log + check grid. Right: KEV/CVE feed with CVSS scores.
All 9 checks + CVE list + SOAR strip packed into one viewport. Oversized red cell for 'open failures'. No decoration. Status-colored borders only.
